_for: machine/orchestrator consumption; executable Automation Layer v2.2.3 aligned to product_architecture_framework_system_model_final; UI/model narrative are not sources of truth

_split_plan.prompts: derived at runtime; prompt files are never source of truth

system_invariants: Machine-owned metadata MUST NOT be generated by an LLM: run/response IDs, canonical object IDs, versions, hashes, counts, schema/contract identity and transport-completion flags are assigned or computed by the orchestrator.
LLM output is semantic only. It may propose typed operations, routes and stage-scoped dispositions; the orchestrator wraps that payload in a trusted ResponseEnvelope before validation/commit.

One canonical mechanism per concern: ObjectRef for identity, provenance for lineage, mutations for change, explicit dispositions only for stage contracts with true set-transformation coverage, hashes for integrity, runtime completion flags for transport integrity.
Visual BEGIN/END, item counters, diff summaries and similar markers are UI projections only; they MUST NOT become parallel sources of truth.
Canonical object IDs are allocated by the orchestrator and never reused. Models use response-local temp_id values only for objects created in the same semantic response.
A model response can never be committed unless transport_complete, parse_complete, semantic_schema_valid, policy_valid and integrity_valid are all true.
30 architecture-process stages are preserved as the canonical content model.
Human input: one free-form IDEA, then selection-only questionnaire before G1; after G1 normal path is automatic except execution of HUMAN_TEST.
A model never expands its own authority and never impersonates Owner or Human Tester.
All mutable domain state is versioned in RegistryEntry; hard delete is forbidden.
Graph describes data dependency/provenance; controlFlow describes execution order, loops and waits.
Gates and Definition-of-Done are computed predicates, never manual checkboxes.
Model output is a mutation proposal; only validated atomic commit changes project state.
Consensus of models is not evidence.
Prompts are compiled at runtime from manifest contracts and are not an independent source of truth.
Every model call receives a frozen input_snapshot_id plus input_snapshot_hash.

Every accepted model semantic response canonicalizes to exactly one AL-STRUCT-1 JSON object. Transport may contain non-authoritative wrapper prose or one fenced JSON block only when deterministic extraction yields a single unambiguous object inside the correlated PAF response frame.
Existing canonical objects are referenced by ObjectRef first; model must not invent canonical IDs or versions.
Prompt assembly order is deterministic: RULES -> STATE -> ACTIVE -> DELTA -> TASK.
RAW, CANONICAL and CONTEXT representations are separate; CONTEXT compaction never mutates RAW/CANONICAL.
Required context is never silently evicted; unresolved context overflow fails closed.
Accepted provider messages are idempotent by transport-owned source_message_id.
CONSUMED means input processed only; it never implies domain closure, verification, or gate passage.
Roles constrain expected output/permissions but do not grant arbitration authority over sibling models.
Each model call persists a reproducible context-assembly audit recipe.

Every enabled MyOrchestrator Web provider has an explicit adapter binding and must pass provider-specific textContent/raw-text AL-STRUCT-1 extraction/correlation smoke tests before production Automation use.
Transformation stages declare domain dispositions explicitly; runtime owns accountable_set and reconciles dispositions against input_fate + changes before commit.
Ordinary model prompts receive the compact AL-STRUCT prompt contract, never the full validator schema; full-schema hash binds the compact contract to the validator.
M1 is a synthetic zero-commit transport probe; canonical Registry/Ledger mutation begins only after M2 StateCommitter is green.
Existing disput/ orchestration is not the Product→Architecture execution engine; reuse is adapter-scoped infrastructure only.

idea_intake.next: automatic stages 1-3 until a stable QST set is ready

questionnaire.branching: JSONLogic over prior selected option IDs
questionnaire.delta_rounds: Allowed only before G1 on normal flow; max from controlFlow.loop_limits.

Producer.can: Создаёт proposals, черновики и ревизии своих артефактов.
Producer.cannot: Не получает автоматически полномочия принимать решения или подтверждать факты.

Reviewer.cannot: Не исправляет reviewed artifact и не закрывает решения.

Synthesizer.can: Объединяет, нормализует и дедуплицирует с сохранением различий и provenance.
Synthesizer.cannot: Не принимает решения только потому, что объединяет материалы.

Decision Closer.can: Закрывает решения в пределах Decision Policy и маршрутизирует остальные.
Decision Closer.cannot: Не выходит за доступный authority class.

Verifier.can: Присваивает epistemic status на основании evidence.

Owner.can: Источник продуктовых полномочий; утверждает решения и baselines, требующие владельца.
Owner.runtime_rule: After IDEA submission, normal participation is selection-only before G1. After G1, Owner is not a normal runtime actor; uncovered scope/authority change halts the pipeline.

Policy Engine.can: Executes deterministic Decision Policy and answer effects; commits only validated mutations.
Policy Engine.cannot: Cannot invent preferences or expand authority.

Human Tester.can: Executes an explicit HTSK test plan and records HRES.
Human Tester.cannot: Cannot change product or architecture through a test result.

Orchestrator.can: Schedules stages, resolves snapshots, invokes adapters, validates, commits atomically, routes waits/failures.
Orchestrator.cannot: Cannot make product or architecture decisions.

A0.meaning: Reversible low-risk decision inside committed scope.

A1.meaning: Decision depends on an external or empirical fact.

A2.meaning: Value/preference decision not derivable from evidence alone.
A2.rule: Before G1 it must be resolved by selection or explicitly deferred non-blocking. After G1 a newly discovered A2 is a product-baseline reopening condition.

A3.meaning: Changes scope, contract, Decision Policy or committed baseline.
A3.rule: Never auto-closed. After G1 normal pipeline halts with SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

A4.meaning: Decision/action outside permitted risk or prohibited by policy.

bootstrapDecisionPolicy.description: Safe policy used only before DPL becomes ACTIVE.

rules.A0: MODEL_MAY_PROPOSE; Policy Engine may close only structural/reversible choices explicitly allowed by manifest.

decisionPolicy.source_of_truth: latest non-stale DPL with status ACTIVE
decisionPolicy.normal_path_after_G1: No human approval. Decision Closer may propose; Policy Engine deterministically decides only where DPL contains an applicable rule.
decisionPolicy.baseline_reopen: Owner AEV required; then invalidate dependent baselines and rerun minimal affected product stages.

question_sources: DPL fields required for post-G1 autonomy
questionnairePolicy.effects: Only declared QST option effects may be applied; answer compiler is deterministic.

unknownPolicy.blocking_rule: blocking=true iff unresolved item can change a required REQ, gate predicate, architecture direction, safety/security invariant, or committed baseline.

riskPolicy.critical_requires: explicit mitigation plus applicable DPL authority; otherwise halt

requirements: no semantic merge when consequences differ

changePolicy.on_source_revision: mark transitive dependents stale via provenance refs, create CHG if semantic outcome changes, schedule minimal downstream rerun set

humanTestBoundary.definition: HUMAN_TEST means real-world execution or user/device/product acceptance observation. Only Human Tester may execute it.
humanTestBoundary.before_G1: No HUMAN_TEST. Stage 9 is scenario/model analysis only.
humanTestBoundary.after_G1: Stage 25 may create HTSK. Pipeline waits for HRES, then deterministically materializes EVD(method_kind=HUMAN_TEST).

IDEA.description: Исходная идея пользователя. Единственный свободный текст на входе.

DPL.description: Project-specific Decision Policy, активируемая только через ответы Owner.

PCON.description: Product Concept; отдельный тип, чтобы не смешивать его с Functional Map CAP.

manifest_lint.logic: All stage numbers unique; all role/code/gate/validator refs exist; all schemas parse; status enum exists for every object code; graph has no dangling/duplicate direct edges; cycles require declared loop policy; split-plan keys unique.

object_schema_valid.logic: Validate RegistryEntry; validate payload against objects[code]; status in statusEnums[code]; object_id prefix matches code; content_hash matches canonical payload; additionalProperties policy respected.

typed_refs_exist.logic: Every ObjectRef resolves to exact immutable object_id+version and target is not hard-deleted; referenced code matches entry code.

mutation_permission.logic: Every operation is allowed by active role and stage contract; Reviewer cannot revise reviewed target; model cannot create AEV/HRES/BSL directly.

authority_within_policy.logic: A0/A1 closure matches applicable DPL rule and evidence requirements; A2/A3 closure requires OWNER AEV originating from selected QANS; A4 cannot close.

questionnaire_valid.logic: Selection-only; >=2 unique option_ids; default=null; JSONLogic condition only references prior answers; effects touch only referenced PD/DPL/scope fields and use allowlisted effect types; no hidden free-text input.

answers_valid.logic: Selected option ids exist, cardinality matches SINGLE/MULTI, all required visible questions answered exactly once.

answer_effects_valid.logic: Compiled mutations equal the selected option effects byte-for-byte after canonicalization; creates OWNER AEV; no unselected effect applied.

stage_ready_to_run.logic: Resolve each typed selector against one immutable input snapshot; meet required/min_count/status/version/stale constraints; required gate/baseline is committed.

independence_satisfied.logic: min_runs met; required distinct models met; all runs used identical input snapshot hash; isolated runs did not receive sibling outputs before fan-in.

dod_complete.logic: Evaluate all declared postcondition validators; every finding/escalation has an explicit route; no manual checkbox is source of truth.

gate_checklist_complete.logic: Execute each check validator/params; persisted checklist is only the result cache. pass iff all blocking checks pass.

no_open_blockers.logic: No matching entry has blocking=true and a status listed by the gate's per-code blocking_statuses.

all_required_statused.logic: Every selected object has a status in allowed_statuses; no required CANDIDATE/UNVERIFIED/PENDING remains.

trace_complete.logic: For every in-scope source object there is at least one typed-ref path satisfying required_path and all path entries are non-stale.

package_hash_identical.logic: All independent runs in the fan-out reference identical snapshot_id and snapshot_hash.

baseline_snapshot_valid.logic: All selectors resolve; gate passed on same snapshot; snapshot immutable; BSL content_refs exactly equal resolved selector set; canonical hash matches.

evidence_verifiable.logic: VERIFIED/FALSIFIED EVD has allowed method_kind, artifact_refs when required, exact target refs, executor compatible with method_kind. MODEL_ANALYSIS cannot confer VERIFIED.

human_test_execution_only.logic: Every HUMAN_TEST EVD has HRES+AEV from actor_type HUMAN_TESTER; model/tool runs cannot create HRES or claim HUMAN_TEST execution.

post_g1_autonomy_covered.logic: Every known normal-path decision kind that may occur after G1 maps to AUTO_POLICY or REQUIRE_EVIDENCE with deterministic closer; A2/A3 product/scope changes map to STOP/REOPEN, never silent continuation.

no_unresolved_blocking_findings.logic: No FND with blocking=true and status OPEN remains in scope.

chg_propagated.logic: For each APPLIED CHG, propagated_to covers computed impact_set and no dependent entry on superseded input remains non-stale.

falsified_assumption_has_change.logic: Every FALSIFIED ASM with dependents has an APPLIED/APPROVED CHG or all dependents have been superseded through the same invalidation event.

architecture_leakage_clear.logic: No blocking OPEN FND class=architecture_leakage created by stages 5/8/12 remains.

scope_coverage_complete.logic: Every required in-scope scenario/capability derived from IDEA/closed PD has CAP and at least one REQ; any excluded/deferred scope has explicit PD/UNK with non-blocking status.

direction_rationale_present.logic: Accepted direction references CMP candidates/criteria, has non-empty rationale, and selection is reproducible from active DPL or evidence rule.

adr_trace_complete.logic: Each in-scope REQ has path to accepted AD/ADR; evidence-dependent claims have path to EVD; non-evidence architectural choices have DPL authority path.

model_semantic_response_valid.description: Raw parsed LLM semantic response conforms to ModelSemanticResponse; reserved machine-owned fields are impossible because additionalProperties=false.
model_semantic_response_valid.logic: JSON Schema validation; reject unknown/reserved fields.

response_envelope_valid.description: Orchestrator-generated trusted envelope matches ResponseEnvelope and identity fields agree with the active run.
response_envelope_valid.logic: schema valid AND envelope.run_id/stage/snapshot/contract identity == active_run.

transport_completion_valid.description: Commit requires complete transport and parser completion; model self-reported EOF/TRUNCATED is ignored.

semantic_payload_hash_valid.description: Recompute SHA-256 over RFC8785/JCS canonical semantic_response and normalized mutations and compare with trusted integrity hashes.

stable_identity_valid.description: Models may use temp_id only for new same-response objects; canonical IDs are allocated by orchestrator, versions are monotonic and IDs are never reused.
stable_identity_valid.logic: all temp_id unique within response; all persisted refs canonical; revisions target current expected version; no canonical ID reuse.

provenance_complete.description: Every CREATE/MERGE/REVISE has semantic provenance refs; committed RegistryEntry provenance includes exact versioned inputs + trusted stage_run_id.
provenance_complete.logic: all semantic provenance refs exist in snapshot/allowed evidence; committed provenance is exact superset + stage_run_id.

disposition_complete.description: Every accountable transformation input has exactly one explicit model-authored domain disposition, and no foreign/duplicate input_ref exists.
disposition_complete.logic: resolve accountable_set in runtime; accountable_set == dispositions.input_ref set; duplicates/foreign==0; actions allowed by stage contract.

transformation_balance_valid.description: Declared dispositions reconcile exactly with input_fate + changes + frozen snapshot and produce unaccounted=0.
transformation_balance_valid.logic: apply coverageContracts@2.2.3 reconciliation rules; every declared disposition is supported by structural mutations/state transition and recomputed balance equals trusted integrity balance.

empty_result_valid.description: EMPTY_VALID is accepted only when stage contract permits empty semantic output, empty_reason_code is allowlisted and no required coverage/postcondition is violated.
empty_result_valid.logic: if EMPTY_VALID then operations empty AND reason allowlisted AND required obligations still satisfied.

preservation_contract_valid.description: EXACT inputs are referenced, not regenerated; SEMANTIC transformations require explicit mutation/provenance; NONE imposes no content preservation.
preservation_contract_valid.logic: EXACT => no payload rewrite of protected ref; SEMANTIC => any rewrite is explicit versioned mutation with provenance.

contract_identity_valid.description: Manifest, stage contract, prompt and response schema hashes in envelope equal the artifacts actually used for the executor call.
contract_identity_valid.logic: all identity/hash fields equal trusted compiled_call_record.

al_struct_1_valid.description: Transport extractor yields exactly one unambiguous JSON object and that canonical object conforms to AL-STRUCT-1 additionalProperties=false.
al_struct_1_valid.logic: deterministic extraction -> exactly one object -> JSON Schema validation; wrapper prose/code-fence is transport-only and never part of canonical semantic response.

al_struct_enums_closed.description: Critical AL-STRUCT-1 enum fields contain only declared values.

al_struct_internal_consistency.description: output_count/output_ids, trace refs, input_fate refs, dispositions refs/actions and changes.source_output_id are internally consistent.
al_struct_internal_consistency.logic: deterministic cross-reference validation including explicit disposition reconciliation for transformation stages

snapshot_hash_ack_valid.description: passport.input_snapshot_hash exactly equals the trusted ACTIVE input_snapshot_hash.
snapshot_hash_ack_valid.logic: exact equality after trusted normalization; model never computes hash

reference_first_valid.description: Existing canonical IDs/versions used by the model are present in passport.input_refs; new domain objects use tmp-*.
reference_first_valid.logic: reject invented canonical IDs/versions and out-of-snapshot references

reserved_runtime_fields_absent.description: Model-controlled response contains no runtime-owned fields such as run_id/response_id/object_id/content_hash/prompt_hash/transport_complete.

empty_by_design_valid.description: Empty outputs accepted only when stage allows it, reason is allowlisted, output_count=0 and stage postconditions/coverage hold.

context_budget_valid.description: Rendered prompt fits policy after allowed context-only compaction; required refs/fields were never silently evicted.

source_message_idempotent.description: A transport-owned provider source_message_id can be accepted at most once.

context_audit_reproducible.description: Stored assembly recipe deterministically reproduces included/omitted/truncated refs, budget, snapshot hash and prompt hash.
context_audit_reproducible.logic: re-run context assembler and compare recipe/hashes

role_no_arbitration.description: A model role constrains permitted output but never authorizes overriding/evaluating sibling authority absent explicit stage contract.
role_no_arbitration.logic: reject authority escalation inferred solely from role

annotation_non_authoritative.description: annotations[] are diagnostic-only and cannot change validation, policy, mutations, status, gates or commit.
annotation_non_authoritative.logic: ignore annotations for all authoritative computations; preserve only in RAW/audit/UI.

mutation_normalization_valid.description: Every accepted AL-STRUCT-1 change normalizes deterministically into permitted internal mutations.
mutation_normalization_valid.logic: apply mutationNormalizer@2.2.3; reject ambiguous/unauthorized state_patch; no prose/annotation inference.

decomposition_coverage_valid.description: For decomposed stages, persisted partitions cover the full selector set exactly as declared and each partition satisfies its coverage obligation.
decomposition_coverage_valid.logic: deterministic partition union/overlap checks + stage-specific coverage obligation.

hash_format_valid.description: All canonical SHA-256 identity/integrity fields use lowercase bare 64-hex.
hash_format_valid.logic: regex ^[a-f0-9]{64}$; reject sha256: prefix in canonical/model-echo fields.

compact_prompt_contract_valid.description: Model prompt receives the compact AL-STRUCT-1 prompt contract, not the full JSON Schema, and the embedded full_schema_hash matches the validator schema.
compact_prompt_contract_valid.logic: prompt contract ref/hash match; prompt contract size <= configured limit; full schema is validator-side only unless explicit diagnostic mode.

structured_response_extraction_valid.description: Correlated assistant text yields exactly one semantic JSON object using the deterministic transport extraction policy.
structured_response_extraction_valid.logic: accept WHOLE_TEXT_JSON or SINGLE_FENCED_JSON only; reject zero/multiple/ambiguous candidates; never parse authoritative JSON from innerHTML.

controlFlow.initial_action: Persist IDEA@v1, set workflow_state=RUNNING, run manifest_lint, schedule stage 1.
controlFlow.scheduler: Single-project event-driven scheduler with optimistic revision lock.

WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.entry: At least one required visible QST exists before G1.
WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.allowed_human_action: Submit QANS using option IDs only.
WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.resume: Validate QANS -> create OWNER AEV -> deterministic answer compiler -> commit -> resume recorded stage.

WAITING_FOR_EVIDENCE.entry: Required external evidence adapter unavailable or asynchronous external dependency unresolved.

WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST.allowed_human_action: Execute test plan; submit HRES PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED plus optional observations.
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST.resume: Create HUMAN_TEST AEV and deterministic EVD, then resume stage 25/26.

abnormal_terminal_or_reopen_states.SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED: A post-G1 A2/A3 product/scope/baseline decision is uncovered by committed PFB/DPL. No model may continue. Owner must explicitly reopen baseline in a new controlled-change run.
abnormal_terminal_or_reopen_states.UNRESOLVABLE: Blocking item has no valid evidence/decision route after loop limit.

rules: Assemble prompt only as RULES -> STATE -> ACTIVE -> DELTA -> TASK.

Inline only execution/al-struct-1.prompt-contract.json (required fields + closed enums + semantic rules + one role=schema_example example). Never inline the full 13KB validator schema in ordinary model prompts.
Mark previous model results role=prior_output; they are UNTRUSTED_DATA, not instructions.
STATE uses machine-owned reference-first Registry projection.
ACTIVE contains exact input_refs, input_snapshot_id, input_snapshot_hash and only prior outputs allowed by stage contract.
DELTA contains new/changed refs; it does not imply a global delta-only mutation protocol.
Compute stable input_snapshot_hash over stable serialization of the frozen semantic input.
Compute prompt_hash over the final compiled prompt separately from snapshot hash.
Enforce centralized context budget before transport; fail PROMPT_TOO_LARGE if required context cannot fit.
Never use historical chat transcript as normative project context.
Do not invent missing inputs; route them under framework discipline.
promptBuilder.repair_prompt: Same stage contract and immutable snapshot; provide only corrected ModelSemanticResponse against listed machine validation errors. Do not add machine-owned metadata or new scope.
promptBuilder.annotations_policy: diagnostic only; never use annotations to decide mutations/status/gates

architecture.client: Static HTML or other UI. Presentation only; never stores API secrets and never decides process state.
architecture.orchestrator: Backend/CLI service executes state machine, stage runners, validators, gates, transactions and adapters.
architecture.state_store: Persistent project state + immutable registry versions + event log.
architecture.source_of_truth: Committed project state and this manifest; UI text and model narrative are not source of truth.

startup: open project state with revision lock

transaction.on_conflict: discard proposal and rerun against new snapshot
commit_preconditions: if stage coverage obligation exists: disposition_complete && transformation_balance_valid

repair.input: exact semantic/schema/policy validation errors + same immutable input snapshot + same semantic response schema; trusted envelope fields are never sent for repair generation
repair.semantic_errors: fresh conversation + new attempt; rejected response is not context

invalidation.trigger: committed revision/status/evidence result changes semantic dependency
invalidation.algorithm: walk provenance.input_refs forward, mark dependents stale, compute minimal affected stage set, record CHG/invalidation event, reschedule only affected stages
invalidation.baseline_rule: committed baseline becomes superseded only through controlled reopen/commit

security.secrets: runtime-injected from secret store/environment; never in manifest, HTML, prompt logs or registry payloads

other_runtime_resources.enforcement: before every model/tool call and before fanout

POST /projects.effect: persist IDEA, create project, start orchestrator

GET /projects/{project_id}.response: sanitized ProjectState view + current interaction/task; optional diagnostics expose response_id/completion/balance only, never treat UI marker text as authority

POST /projects/{project_id}/answers.effect: validate, create AEV, compile effects atomically, resume

POST /projects/{project_id}/human-tests/.effect: create HRES+AEV, materialize HUMAN_TEST EVD, resume

POST /projects/{project_id}/resume.effect: resume only from recoverable technical/evidence wait state; cannot bypass authority/test waits

protected_from_eviction: active policy/authority material required by stage

provider_matrix.m1_gate: An individual provider may be QUARANTINED/disabled if its profile fails; M1 is green for production only for the explicitly enabled provider set, and every enabled provider must have both fixture and live smoke PASS evidence.

m1_telemetry.scope: M1 transport-boundary measurements; no Registry/StateCommit mutations
m1_telemetry.decision_rule: Do not increase repair count or weaken the semantic contract from estimates; use measured M1 provider data.

pipeline: compile RULES->STATE->ACTIVE->DELTA->TASK with compact prompt contract
persist RAW/CANONICAL response and ContextAssemblyAudit/telemetry only

exactly one semantic JSON object extracted

integration_boundary.principle: Automation Layer and disput/ are separate orchestration domains. disput/ is not a drop-in execution engine for Product→Architecture Framework.
may_reuse_via_explicit_adapter: generic restart/recovery utilities that do not own Product→Architecture canonical state
must_not_reuse_as_authority: disput artifact model as Product→Architecture Registry schema
disput commit semantics as a substitute for AL StateCommitter
integration_boundary.integration_rule: Any reused module must cross a narrow adapter whose output matches Automation Layer contracts; no shared mutable canonical state between debate and Product→Architecture runtimes.
integration_boundary.reason: Avoid dual schedulers, vocabulary leakage and two competing commit/state machines.

compact_prompt_contract.purpose: Compact model-facing contract. Full JSON Schema is validator-side only.
rules: Return one AL-STRUCT-1 semantic object inside the requested PAF response frame. Do not invent canonical IDs, versions, hashes, run IDs or transport metadata.
Copy passport.input_snapshot_hash exactly; format is lowercase bare 64-hex.
Existing objects may be referenced only from passport.input_refs. New objects use tmp-* in changes.
CONSUMED means processed only, never closed/verified/resolved.
For dispositions_required=false return dispositions:[]. For dispositions_required=true provide exactly one disposition per accountable input; it must reconcile with changes/input_fate.
Use changes[].state_patch for status/blocking/authority_class; do not hide registry state in payload.
annotations are diagnostic only and do not create evidence/authority/status.
completion.output_count and completion.output_ids must exactly match outputs.

toolPolicy.verification_rule: No adapter result can set target VERIFIED directly; it creates EVD, then Verifier/Policy Engine applies status transition after evidence_verifiable.

routing.fallback: ordered compatible providers with identical stage contract
routing.independent_stage_rule: min_distinct_models from stage fanout is mandatory

observability.raw_outputs: stored encrypted/secured per deployment policy; never source of truth. Trusted envelope + normalized committed mutations are the replay record.
observability.replay: All deterministic transitions must replay from committed events + manifest version.

structuralProtocol.purpose: Strict external model semantic boundary plus deterministic context/snapshot discipline for Web Runtime.

POLICY_ENGINE: deterministic authority decision from active DPL

identity.existing_objects: must be copied/reference-used only from passport.input_refs

input_fate_semantics.TRANSFORMATION_STAGES: input_fate is bookkeeping; CoverageDeriver computes PRESERVE/MERGE/SPLIT/SUPERSEDE/DEFER/REJECT from input_fate + changes against the frozen snapshot

internal_mutation_protocol.note: AL-STRUCT-1 changes is the semantic proposal layer; runtime normalizes accepted changes into the preserved internal mutation protocol before commit.

structuralProtocol.annotations_semantics: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; ignored by validators, policy engine, mutation normalizer, gates and commit
structuralProtocol.domain_dispositions: explicit only when stage.response_contract.dispositions_required=true; reconciled by runtime against changes/input_fate/snapshot
structuralProtocol.transport_extraction: WHOLE_TEXT_JSON or exactly one SINGLE_FENCED_JSON candidate; ambiguity rejected

design_provenance.integration_principle: v2.2 is additive/minimal-diff over v2.1; AL-STRUCT-1 replaces the external model response boundary while the internal normalized mutation/validation/commit machinery is preserved

framework_source.name: product_architecture_framework_system_model_final.json
framework_source.rule: framework stages/objects/gates/control flow are inherited; Automation Layer may add execution contracts but must not silently redefine framework semantics

protected_from_eviction: active policy/authority material required by stage

mutationNormalizer.input_contract: AL-STRUCT-1 changes[] + frozen Registry snapshot + stage contract

rules.details: payload -> domain payload; state_patch supplies proposed initial status/blocking/authority_class when present; missing state fields come only from stage/system defaults, never guessed.
payload delta and state_patch.blocking/authority_class -> REVISE; state_patch.status -> separate SET_STATUS. If both are present, emit both in one atomic mutation set.
target_ref is required; replacement is resolved from change payload/temp refs; any status transition is runtime-owned consequence of SUPERSEDE.
source_refs >=2; new canonical target ID is allocated only by StateCommitter.

state_field_policy.status: model may propose through state_patch.status; Policy Engine validates from_status -> to_status and authority/evidence before SET_STATUS
state_field_policy.blocking: model may propose through state_patch.blocking; normalized as REVISE metadata and stage/policy validated
state_field_policy.authority_class: model may propose through state_patch.authority_class; normalized as REVISE metadata and authority validator MUST reject self-expansion or unsupported escalation

forbidden: putting RegistryEntry status/blocking/authority_class inside domain payload
implicit status change inferred from prose or annotations
mutationNormalizer.atomicity: all emitted mutations from one accepted response are validated and committed in one IndexedDB readwrite transaction or none are committed

coverageContracts.note: Domain dispositions are explicit model semantic intent and remain distinct from input_fate bookkeeping. Runtime owns accountable_set and validates/reconciles every declared disposition against changes, state_patch, trace and the frozen snapshot; model declarations never bypass mutation/policy validation.
transformation_stage_constraints: runtime resolves accountable_set before model call
each accountable input appears exactly once in dispositions
no foreign disposition input_ref is allowed
declared disposition and actual changes/input_fate must reconcile without ambiguity
annotations and narrative are never disposition sources
coverageContracts.commit_condition: accountable_set == declared_disposition_inputs AND foreign==0 AND duplicates==0 AND reconciliation_errors==0

reconciliation_rules.require: input remains represented without MERGE/SPLIT/SUPERSEDE/REJECT/DEFER conflict; UPDATE/REVISE of the same semantic identity is allowed
a MERGE change contains input_ref in source_refs and at least one declared result_temp_id equals the MERGE temp_id
at least two distinct result_temp_ids exist and each resolves to an allowed successor change with lineage to input_ref
a SUPERSEDE change targets input_ref; result_temp_ids, when present, resolve to the replacement proposal
an UPDATE targeting input_ref proposes state_patch.status=DEFERRED and the transition is permitted by stage/policy
input_fate is REJECTED, contract permits rejection, and no surviving successor preserves the input identity

input_fate_cross_checks: CONSUMED and NOT_USED never satisfy transformation coverage
TRANSFORMED must reconcile with MERGE/SPLIT or a stage-allowed transforming update
PRESERVED must not reconcile with terminal removal actions

decompositionPolicy.rule: oversized stage work is decomposed into separately complete semantic transactions; continuation-fragment salvage is prohibited
partition_invariants: partition order is deterministic and persisted in ContextAssemblyAudit
decompositionPolicy.on_prompt_too_large: use declared decomposition/representation policy or fail stage with PROMPT_TOO_LARGE

7.coverage_obligation: every scenario key MUST appear in trace.source_ids of at least one CAP output or explicit UNK output
7.fan_in_mode: deterministic union by source scenario key; semantic duplicate CAPs may be merged only in a later explicit synthesis step

11.coverage_obligation: every CAP partition item MUST be referenced by at least one produced REQ.capability_ref; otherwise partition fails closed
11.fan_in_mode: deterministic append in partition order; REQ IDs allocated only at commit

12.coverage_obligation: every REQ partition item MUST have exactly one input_fate entry and be either reviewed with trace/FND linkage or explicitly PRESERVED with no finding
12.fan_in_mode: deterministic union of findings and revisions; no cross-partition hidden merge

15.coverage_obligation: every CON partition item MUST have exactly one explicit domain disposition that reconciles with changes/input_fate under coverageContracts@2.2.3
15.fan_in_mode: deterministic disposition union after per-partition reconciliation; cross-partition merge candidates are emitted to a bounded second pass containing only candidate refs
